name: Message Queue
description: Idempotent message queue with rate-limit recovery across all messaging channels. Queues messages that fail due to rate limits, schedules retries, and processes them when limits clear.

queuePath.description: Absolute path to the queue state file. Defaults to <workspace>/message-queue-state.json

maxRetries.description: Maximum retry attempts per message before marking failed

defaultRetryDelayMs.description: Default delay in ms when retry-after is not parseable
